Subject: Recap from discovery — quick priority check

Hi Alexandra —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

Summary of the call
- Use case: realtime semantic search inside DataFrame's internal docs for analyst workflows (short latency, embed + rerank).
- Constraints: on-prem data residency for PII subsets; target 200 concurrent queries during peak.
- Success metric: 60% reduction in time-to-insight for analysts on the pilot dataset.

Why Redwood looks like a fit (short)
1) Model serving profile: optimized for 100–200 token responses with low tail latency.
2) Deployment flexibility: hosted POC or private VPC option for the residency requirement.
3) Observability: token-level cost & latency breakdowns that map to your query mix.

Proposed next steps
- I attached discovery_notes.pdf with notes and an initial recommended pilot plan.
- If still useful, can we lock a 30-min slot next week to review pilot scope + stakeholders? (Options: Tue 5/4 10:00–10:30 PT or Wed 5/5 14:00–14:30 PT)
- If procurement needs a short summary, I can pull together a one-page fit doc.

If the timeline has shifted, no problem — just let me know where this ranks and I’ll adjust outreach.

Thanks — looking forward.

—
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Alexandra —

Attached is a concise one-pager (redwood_fit_one-pager.pdf) you can forward to the CISO/procurement. Below is an ultra-short summary you can paste into Slack or an internal note: 

Redwood is a low-latency inference platform that can run open models in-hosted, dedicated, or private VPC modes. For DataFrame’s pilot we recommend a private VPC with prefix/KV caching to keep tail latency under 150ms for the expected query mix, and a scoped dataset pilot that demonstrates a 50–70% improvement in analyst time-to-insight versus current search. We support KMS integrations for key management and provide audit logs required for SOC-style reviews.

Suggested follow-up: 30-min pilot scope call the week of 5/24 — I can share a lightweight SOW and pilot checklist. Will re-propose slots if those work.
